lines.text: All units, prepare for orbital insertion.
[radio] Copy that Commander. Adjusting trajectory now.
Radar shows clear path. No debris detected.
Good. Pilot, take us in. [pause:1.5] Smooth and steady.
[robot] Warning. Atmospheric friction exceeding nominal parameters.
[radio] Compensating. Hull temperature is within tolerance.
Picking up a signal on the surface. [pause:0.8] Unidentified.
[angry] Can you get a fix on it?
Working on it. Signal is… intermittent.
[robot] Landing zone secured. Touchdown in thirty seconds.
